Priority:
High
Possible solution: The error that we are facing is "
AC1: contactor opened unexpectedly: stop charging
"
Please check the following circuits during a AC charging session:
I believe that there can only be 1 of 3 options:
QA8 is opening in L1/L2/L3
QA8 is not getting 24V between A1-A2
QA8:13-14 is opening even though the real contactors are closed.
KF13 is not sending the voltage or it gets lost
BC5 stops sending voltage.
I recommend you to take these 3 parts as spare.
